g.text: GPTpatient modernization · Delivery
// Local and production deployment requests
Local Compose starts Nuxt · API · PostgreSQL · Redis · background workers
Configure Redis event stream · background persistence · 20-minute expiry · 72-hour archive
Expose only web entry point to host
Bind PostgreSQL / Redis to private Compose network
Keep credentials in ignored env file or secret manager
Build immutable · pinned Nuxt and API images
Terminate HTTPS at ingress proxy
Route /api and SSE to Express API
Route authenticated audio WebSocket to API
Keep PostgreSQL / Redis private
Configure health · readiness · graceful socket drain
Enforce body size · origin / CSRF · rate limits
Redact logs
do not log patient turns · keys · cookies · audio
Add request and turn correlation IDs
// Greenfield implementation sequence and explicit acceptance gates
1 · Define seed · expansion · event · phase · action · retention schemas
Medical educators review sample cases and rubric
2 · Implement OIDC · tenant ownership · roles · entitlements · quotas
Verify cross-tenant session access is denied
3 · Add PostgreSQL constraints and idempotent structured setup
Verify setup retries preserve exactly the same seed
4 · Build serialized Responses turns · expansions · disclosure · reconnect
Verify accepted facts survive reconnect and remain consistent
5 · Build fixed results · consent-aware exams · assessment · debrief
Verify unsupported findings and results cannot be created
6 · Ship Transcript
prototype private server-bridged Full Audio
Verify reconnect · barge-in · transcript reconciliation · privacy
7 · Ship Nuxt / API with PostgreSQL · Redis JSON · archive lifecycle
8 · Educator evaluation · load tests · latency and cost budgets
Do quality and performance evidence meet release criteria?
Release after clinical · security · reliability gates pass
